scope: Independent standard-method implementation and source-quality assessment

nfl.train: 2000 through test season minus 3; REG only
nfl.tune: test season minus 2; no refit after selection
nfl.calibrate: test season minus 1; binary non-ties only
nfl.test: complete next regular season; models frozen for entire test season
nfl.selection_metric: tuning-season margin MAE, first grid entry wins ties
nfl.calibration: LogisticRegression C=1 on calibration-season predicted margin; sigmoid only
nfl.raw_probability: Normal CDF using frozen training residual RMSE; diagnostic
comparisons: ridge_coaching versus ridge_base: coaching feature group only
sigmoid versus raw: probability map only
nfl.pit_status: RETROSPECTIVE_UNVERIFIED_PUBLICATION_TIMES; observation ordering is enforced but this is not certified historical PIT
nfl.promotion: NONE; development screening only, holdout sealed

wnba.lineup: five unique offensive IDs and five unique defensive IDs; defense design entries -1
wnba.data_gate: nonnegative integer points <=5, scoring identity 2*fgm+fg3m+ftm and unique game/possession; anomalous source blocks entire fit, no silent trimming

nfl_pbp.use: observed Week 1 feature capture only; no fitted coefficient or production injection
nfl_pbp.pace: same-game same-quarter same-drive consecutive offensive scrimmage snaps, no preceding timeout/out-of-bounds/incompletion/score/penalty; elapsed seconds in [0,40]
nfl_pbp.hvt: receptions plus rush attempts from opponent 10-yard line or closer; descriptive workload, not expected points
